'''Cason''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a supply officer in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Cason was originally to introduce a mission on Balmorra, but the mission was cut before ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' was released. His dialogue remains in the game's text files, and should have been voiced by [[Troy Hall]].
